title: pi-gear configuration
description: Configuration for pi-gear sandboxing, filesystem and network policy, and language servers.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL used by editors for validation and autocomplete. It does not affect runtime behavior.

version.description: pi-gear configuration format version. The current and only supported version is 1.

sandbox.description: Controls Anthropic Sandbox Runtime integration for Bash.

enabled.description: Runs Bash through Anthropic Sandbox Runtime when true. When false, Pi's normal Bash runs directly on the host. Filesystem guards still apply to read, edit, and write.

strictAllowlist.description: When true, denies hosts not matched by an allow rule without requesting interactive approval.

rules.description: Allow and deny rules for hosts reached by sandboxed Bash. Unknown hosts require approval unless strictAllowlist is true.

filesystem.description: Ordered policy rules for Pi's read, edit, and write tools. More restrictive matching rules take precedence.

rules.description: Filesystem access rules. Paths must be unique selectors.

lsp.description: Optional language-server configuration. Omit this property to disable pi-gear LSP support.

idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes before an unused language server stops. Use 0 to disable idle shutdown.

servers.description: Language servers launched lazily for matching file extensions.

path.description: Workspace-relative, absolute, or ~/ path selector. Glob patterns are supported; parent traversal is rejected.

access.description: Maximum access allowed for paths matching this selector.

follow.description: Also applies this rule to the symlink-resolved target. Explicit deny rules on the target still take precedence.

host.description: DNS host, optional wildcard subdomain (for example *.github.com), and optional port.

access.description: Whether sandboxed Bash may connect to the matching host without approval.

extensions.description: File extensions owned by this server, each beginning with a dot.

languageIds.description: Complete mapping from every configured extension to its exact LSP language ID.

command.description: Executable and arguments as an argv array. The command runs without a shell and is not installed automatically.
